ruleDefinitions.name: Session Manager Autorun Keys Modification
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects modification of autostart extensibility point (ASEP) in registry. Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\System\\\\CurrentControlSet\\\\Control\\\\Session\\ Manager.*") AND (registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\SetupExecute.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\S0InitialCommand.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\KnownDlls.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Execute.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\BootExecute.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\AppCertDlls.*")) AND  NOT (Details = "\(Empty\)")
